rationale.conceptual: The method is the paper's own custom micromechanical model. It involves a multi-branch constitutive equation that switches based on each element's temperature relative to its assigned Tg, a prescribed distribution of Tg values, and coupling among elements (equal stress, average strain). Implementing this requires non-trivial translation of the paper's differential equations into code and correct handling of the latch mechanism. Several interacting components make it clearly more than a standard library application.
rationale.execution: The orchestration is simple: one simulation step generates time-series data, then two straightforward extraction steps produce a JSON and a CSV. Only standard Python libraries are needed, no complex data acquisition or multi-tool coordination. The pipeline has only 2-3 stages with linear dependencies.
